description: Integrate pyWhat (https://github.com/bee-san/pyWhat) for automated attack surface identification. Route decrypted traffic from LiveDecryptionSession through pyWhat to identify credentials, API keys, hashes, URLs, IPs, crypto wallets, and other interesting patterns in captured data.
steps: Create posframework/pywhat_analyzer.py with a PyWhatAnalyzer class that: (1) Tries to import pywhat at runtime (optional dependency), (2) Provides a fallback regex-based analyzer for common patterns (API keys, passwords, hashes, IPs, URLs, email addresses, credit cards, crypto wallets, JWT tokens) when pywhat is not installed, (3) Has analyze(text) method returning a list of identified items with type, value, and confidence, (4) Has analyze_traffic(decrypted_summary) method that processes DNS queries, HTTP requests/responses, DHCP data, and credentials from LiveDecryptionSession output, (5) Has get_attack_surfaces() method returning categorized findings (credentials, keys, network info, identifiers).
Add a PyWhatCallback class that can be passed as a callback to LiveDecryptionSession - processes each decrypted frame through pyWhat/fallback analyzer in real-time, accumulates findings.

Integrate PyWhatAnalyzer into ReconEngine: add optional pywhat_enabled parameter, when enabled create PyWhatCallback and pass to LiveDecryptionSession as the callback, log identified attack surfaces during recon.

Create tests/test_pywhat_analyzer.py with unit tests: test analyze() with various input strings (API keys, hashes, URLs, IPs), test analyze_traffic() with mock decrypted summary, test fallback mode when pywhat not installed, test PyWhatCallback integration.
Update requirements.txt to list pywhat as an optional dependency.
acceptance_criteria: PyWhatAnalyzer works without pywhat installed (fallback regex mode)
PyWhatAnalyzer.analyze() identifies at minimum: API keys, hashes (MD5/SHA), URLs, IPs, emails, JWTs
PyWhatCallback integrates with LiveDecryptionSession callback interface
posframework/__init__.py exports new class without syntax errors
